scope: New archive helper and tempfile-only synthetic tests; actual continuation/main evidence has not been archived by this review.

findings: Canonical workspace/data/local_sector_runtime and every declared run.parent are bound before quiet/accounting, closing the independently found namespace bypass.

The separately prepared main runtime inherits the frozen CoordinatorAwake acquisition/release contract; PID, owner thread, 0x80000003 acquire flags, helper=false, 0x80000000 clear flags and permanent=false match.
No-request release is restricted to zero generation attempts and no acquisition event.

guard_changes_after_initial_run: Allow genuine Win32_Process PID 0 but reject bool/non-integer observations.
Bind successful release to exactly one matching acquisition PID/thread/flags event; no-request release requires zero requests and no acquisition.
Require canonical campaign namespace and every declared run parent; reject unlisted new main/continuation declarations.
Reserve ZIP exclusively before entering failure handling so a losing competing writer cannot write another attempt's failure receipt.
Record final ZIP byte size after member checksum verification.
guarantees_checked: Terminal declaration/summary/hash and attempt-count binding before response accounting.
Verified owned-service shutdown reports zero resident models before stop, port closed, executable/PID/creation identity and existing unrelated listener unchanged.
Related process/listener quiescence before and after snapshot; no process or service mutations.
Path traversal, symlink/reparse, duplicate and overlapping roots, self-archive cycles and omitted source references fail closed.
Frozen executable hashes, all bound artifacts and previous archive dependencies are preserved and rechecked.
Exact ZIP inventory, source byte hashes and size/mtime inventory are checked before/after; changed or new evidence leaves an unverified preserved failure artifact.
Main pending versus explicitly included terminal main remains distinct; continuation4/8 and future main5/10 denominators come from the unchanged frozen campaign adapter.
Exclusive outputs, no deletion, no restoration and no success claim for partial/failed archives.
limitations: The prepared plan is an immutable continuation-only candidate with main pending. If main is later executed, create a new reviewed plan with terminal main roots, service/shutdown records and helper roots; this candidate will reject an unlisted new main.
No actual raw-evidence archive has yet been verified. Narrow duplicate ignores are eligible only after a later successful byte-verified archive, and only for exact archived duplicate members.
The archive is provenance preservation; it does not repair allocation/source/citation semantics or declare experimental success or main readiness.
execution_preconditions: Only after all included campaigns are terminal, coordinator acquire/release receipts match, owned service is unloaded/stopped and all report writers are quiet. Use a new plan/stem for changed scope or a previous failed attempt.
status_scope: Implementation and synthetic guards accepted; actual archive execution and verification remain pending.
